programme.desc: Jerry and Napoleon play around with Bigby's brand-new anti-gravity machine ... until Tom breaks into the lab and a chase begins. The machine wrecks havoc on the entire lab, including the cafeteria.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: When Batman teams up with Aquaman to stop a sinister undersea plot, the Batwheels are excited to use their new cool underwater mode!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Meet Atticus Tinhorn, Clara’s greedy, scheming uncle—who wants to claim Dino Island for himself! There’s just one problem… the Cassidys already call it home! Determined to drive them off once and for all, he cooks up a ridiculous (and ridiculously dangerous) plan: smear Boboberry Jam all over the Cassidys to lure the island’s giant fire ants into carrying them away for good!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Uncle Jack and Jon are busy gathering crates of coco-nanas! They know not to go home through Swarm Valley, home to giant dragonflies that love them! Jack and Jon take the safe route, when the Tinhorns swoop in from their hot air balloon and snatch the entire crate from them! Atticus steers the balloon straight toward Swarm Valley, unaware that he’s flying straight into a buzzing nightmare!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Scooby runs into an old kennel mate Axel who is a highly trained Police dog who thinks mystery of the Junk yard monster is too big a case for the gang.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: When a video game company tries to buy an old algorithm from Velma and convince her to work for them in San Francisco, the gang becomes embroiled in the mystery of a video game villain who has seemingly come to life, the Ghost Chef.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang goes to Salem, Massachusetts for a historical festival, only to discover history repeating itself as a demon has been set loose on the town, summoned by a witch as revenge for the infamous 17th Century Salem Witch Trials.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a crate of cell phones: there’s one for everyone. But before being able to play with their new toys, they need to charge the batteries. This operation uses all the electricity stored in the cabin’s solar battery and prevents Grizzy from watching TV. Grizzy soon realizes that this is the least of his worries, for living with the Lemmings and their phones is a guaranteed nonstop stream of noise pollution.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings catch a grasshopper that can give you whatever your heart desires in abundance. All you need to do is set the grasshopper on its head while concentrating hard on what you want. As discretion is not the Lemmings’ strong point, Grizzy ends up understanding where their profusion of toys is coming from. Grizzy decides that it’s his turn to hunt down the grasshopper.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a new passion: magic Chinese lanterns that they use for sound and light performances. Grizzy is not very enthusiastic about this new electric activity which keeps him from sleeping. While Grizzy thinks that he got rid of their lanterns, the Lemmings discover new high-tech lanterns capable of making even more of a ruckus.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay hands on an ancient console that lets you play life-sized games in the real world. The console emits magical streams of energy that randomly pick avatars to confront one another. Grizzy is chosen as the hero. He must leap onto platforms and confront both enemies and a fearsome leader: a panda equipped with bamboo sticks. The Lemmings are obviously in control of the joystick!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: As the Lemmings rummage through an abandoned delivery tricycle filled with strange objects, they discover a delicious treasure: Yummy-filled Chinese brioches! Grizzy steals their tasty bounty and heads off to enjoy it alone in the cabin. The Lemmings find a mask in the tricycle that terrifies anyone who looks at it when it’s being worn by someone. The Lemmings intend to use their horrific new power to recover their stolen treats.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a jar of Yummy which is mysteriously sucked up into a strange gravestone locked with a puzzle. Grizzy smashes open the gravestone but it contains another box made of unbreakable wood protected with a codex system. Our characters crack the code and are sucked into the box in turn. They discover that to get out, they will have to resolve a series of new puzzles, each one more complex than the last.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a giant home cinema screen that transforms his favorite documentary film into an incredible light and sound experience. But his pleasure is ruined by the Lemmings’ fiesta. While he chases after his housemates to destroy their disco equipment, he discovers with astonishment that Asian clones of himself and the Lemmings are also engaged in a high-speed pursuit.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy has anticipated everything for his birthday and plans on spending a peaceful day in the cabin doing his favorite activities. But when the Lemmings find out it’s Grizzy’s birthday, they devise other plans. Farewell, Grizzy’s peaceful day - make way for the Lemmings’ party surprises!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy has adopted a lamb and wants to give it a proper education. The Lemmings have only one desire: play leap-frog with the baby! Grizzy is forced to play policeman and lock the Lemmings in one of the disused tower rooms. But the Lemmings find a strange machine capable of duplicating living beings. They decide to test it out on the lamb.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is taking selfies and enjoying a sweet snack at the candy shop, when Jerry and Tuffy sneak up and eat his strawberries. Tom proceeds to chase after them, but Tuffy falls into the claw machine. Jerry tries to save him, and Tom fishes them out. Tom makes Tuffy cry and apologizes by feeding him sweets.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Jerry is feeling lonely and wishes he had a girlfriend. Spike explains spring fever to Tom and they leave him be. Jerry's mood improves when he gets a message from his brawny cousin Muscles, who has fixed him up with his girlfriend's friend for a double date.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Jerry's country cousins visit the Abbey, the cook is convinced Downton is in the midst of a vermin invasion! Cates (the butler) presses Tom into service with the threat of becoming a stable cat otherwise. Tom pursues the cunning, feisty bumpkins, and Jerry, throughout the manor, and they delight in making surprise appearances to Tom in awkward moments.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Jerry discovers the mysterious phobia cats have toward cucumbers and is inspired to try it out on Tom. After freaking Tom out repeatedly, Butch steps in to counsel Tom and help him overcome his fear, only Butch is far from immune himself. The two encounter more and more trouble as they deal with their phobia.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: A dim-witted cat walks into the detective agency asking for help. It seems he has lost his marbles: He's the city's champion marble player and has either misplaced his case of lucky marbles, or it's been stolen. The cat is desperate to find them before the big tournament. It's up to Tom and Jerry to retrace the cat's steps and solve this mystery.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Ginger and Rick have installed a new birdbath, and Little Quacker has taken up residence in it. Ginger forbids Tom from going out in the back and has Rick move Spike's house. The dog and cat soon unite to return Little Quacker to the pond without Ginger finding out they're responsible for sending him packing.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Little Quacker develops the ability to sing like Pavarotti. But when Tom plots to use this to win a prize on the Pets With Talent TV show, Little Quacker refuses and Jerry covers for him. As things continue to snowball, it's up to Tom to attempt saving the day.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is keen to own a brand new smart phone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do. But after a trip to the mobile phone shop he is horrified at how much they cost and decides to build his own one. Bean’s phone may be bulky but it comes with a whole range of built in gadgets especially useful during a race to The Tower of London.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: A confused Japanese tourist couple mistake Mr Bean’s house for a hotel and because of the language barrier it is difficult to explain otherwise. When the hapless holidaymakers offer to pay to stay Mr Bean and Mrs Wicket see a way of making some money and pretend their house is indeed a hotel. But it’s not long before the tourists start to smell a fish.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is on a photography jaunt in the countryside snapping the normal everyday wildlife – a fox a bird a dinosaur! A DINOSAUR?!! Mr Bean is terrified until he realises what fame and fortune it could bring him. Does he get the photograph of a lifetime or is the situation not quite as it seems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: There’s easy money to be had in the art world and Mr. Bean is set on getting some of it. Once equipped with the right tools, he ventures into the countryside with a blank canvas in search of inspiration – and comes home with a painting full of life. Literally.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Batman calls on an old friend to lend MOE a hand in keeping the Batwheels clean and functional as they take on Condiment King.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When a group of alley dogs, aided by a heroic stray, are saved from Catwoman by kind-hearted Buff, he brings them all back to live in the Batcave, unbeknownst to the rest of the Bat-Family.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Set to his rocking theme song, Bam the Batmobile takes to the streets of Gotham and uses his smarts, leadership skills, and awesome gadgets to fight crime and stop the villainous Legion of Zoom.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Daphne agrees to watch her friend's kid, Wayne, and convinces Fred to take a night off from mysteries to go to the boardwalk amusement park. Unbeknownst to her, though, the park is being haunted by a fiendish clown, Madcap.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang goes on a camping trip, although they can't really agree on why. Fred's desire for the gang to get in touch with their natural instincts and hones their mystery skills, turns into on-the-job training as Viking Ghosts attack and attempt to drive them away – or worse.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Fred is on trial, convicted of being the real mastermind behind all the mysteries he's solved. With the help of his defense attorney, Daphne, we go back over the day's events at a town that had been abandoned since the 1950's because of a toxic chemical spill where a Toxic Mutant has been terrorizing all who dare go near the town.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Unwilling to share the food both he and the Lemmings are wild about, Grizzy locks it up inside the ranger’s brand new and apparently burglar proof safe. He watches the Lemmings’ vain attempts to open the safe with amusement, until he realizes that the string around his neck with the key is far from indestructible.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is impressed by the TV show of a magician who transforms a partridge into a bouquet of flowers. To get rid of the Lemmings once and for all, for they exasperate him with their incessant games, Grizzy tries the magic trick on them. And apparently... it works!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: It's hot out and when Grizzy sees an ice cream commercial on TV, he has a sudden craving. Unfortunately, the Lemmings made it to the deep-freeze in the garage before him and emptied it out to make themselves a sled run in the backyard with strawberry-vanilla ice cream. For Grizzy, there's no question that the stock they possessively watch over in an icebox winds up as powder snow!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: When Lamput masquerades as a swimming trophy at the local pool, Skinny finds himself in his red trunks, warming up for the big race. You’d be surprised at how fast a Doc can swim when there’s a Lamput up for grabs. Skinny discovers skills not even he was aware of. Shame the trophies keep switching places. No lap-time in the world can outsmart this little orange blob.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Traveling to the volcano, Min and Miguel encounter the island’s most fearsome predator: Big Rex! But instead of rampaging, he simply yawns as the ground trembles beneath them! The rumbling stops, replaced by the sound of a lullaby. Min and Miguel climb the volcano to uncover the source, leaving Clover and Tango to stand guard, where they encounter a Parasaur who mimics everything they do!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: On a quest to gather the sweetest yum-yum plums on Dino Island, Uncle Jack shares his prized adventure journal with Jon, a record of every journey he’s taken across the island! Every page tells a story of courage and discovery, except one! The far side of the volcano remains blank! Determined to be the first to fill that empty page, Jon rallies Min and Miguel to join him on a bold new expedition!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines – and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet – but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless – he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm – yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: It's the First Day of Spring and Mr. Bean sets about washing his clothes, his furniture, his teddy and himself. But, alas, there’s no hot water! A bit of inventive improvisation with an outside drainpipe proves Mr. Bean to be greener at D.I.Y. plumbing than he thought.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When they fall into a hollow tree stump, the baby lemmings discover the principle of echoes. They have fun making lots of noise and even humming a little because it's so much fun! But they don't realize that when they sing (in tune), it causes the flowers around them to bloom. Meanwhile, the owl would like the noise to stop so she can finally get some sleep. She is determined to silence her noisy neighbors.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings are playing a game with a moss ball that falls apart too quickly. They discover a hazel tree with huge hazelnuts that are perfect for making their game even more fun! Their neighbor, Baby Chipmunk, who has the largest stockpile of hazelnuts in the whole forest and a veritable internal radar for detecting them, quickly realizes that the Baby Lemmings have found one. She can’t help but steal it for his own hoard. The Baby Lemmings realize that Baby Chipmunk hates to share so they decide to get their ball back and continue their game. Baby Chipmunk’s hoard is very well protected in a hollow tree, however.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The baby lemmings have discovered a new creative passion: land art. By assembling different elements on the ground, they create a beautiful work of art that can be admired from above. Baby Raccoon is horrified by this activity, thinking that the baby lemmings are just making a mess. Baby Raccoon wants to tidy up what he perceives to be the mess made by the baby lemmings.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Squeaks has misplaced his acorns beneath the pitcher's mound of a recently built baseball stadium. Bugs offers his assistance in retrieving them.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Shameless O'Scanty a conniving cloud-riding leprechaun runs out of luck while riding his rainbow over Bugs' forest. Now he needs to gather some luck or he'll never get home.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Squeaks are enjoying a day in the park when the Grim Rabbit comes collecting. Bugs refuses to go without a fight…naturally.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Yosemite Sam hires a Bugs Bunny impersonator to cause mayhem around town. All goes according to plan...Bugs' plan that is.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred lives out his childhood dream of being a stage magician as he and the gang go uncover at a private magic club being terrorized by a mutant Rabbit monster!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang travels back to Ancient Greece, where they play unique roles in a Greek Mystery involving the mythological spider woman, Arachne, and her attempts to disrupt the royal wedding that would unite two great cities!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some cash to take Scrapper to the pet groomer’s, he can’t believe the cost! Instead he buys a basic grooming kit, pockets the rest of the cash and gives the cat a makeover himself, without Mrs Wicket realising. Spotting a business opportunity, Mr Bean then sets himself up as a pet groomer in the back garden. But Mrs Wicket discovers she’s been tricked and now she wants revenge!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lady of the Manor's prize Pomeranian, Alfred, must get some pounds off before the big dog show. The butler suggests exercise—chasing a cat perhaps? Tom happily obliges, as Alfred's successful weight loss guarantees him a cushy spot upstairs. Meanwhile, Jerry aims to sabotage Tom's efforts.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Rick and Ginger go to a couple's retreat, they leave Tom with Rick's Auntie Louella. Hearing that she's a whiz in the kitchen, Jerry comes along. The old woman is sweet, but she has a nasty little lap dog that bedevils Tom like crazy. Louella keeps treating Tom poorly, and Tom and Jerry make their plans to escape.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lady of the House's cousins, the Van der Snoots, visit with their prize-winning Persian cat, Prancy Van der Snoot. Tom is warned to make sure that Snooty doesn't catch sight of the pesky manor mice, lest she get upset or dirty her snowy white paws chasing the vermin. Tom is on it, but nothing goes as planned...

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput gets mistaken for a guide dog, and the Docs try to nab their quarry without disturbing an old lady's pleasant day in front of the wireless. Good thing she can't see the chaos going on.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: While bickering with the Lemmings over control of the TV, Grizzy sees an illustration that gives him an idea. In a medical book, a person whose leg is in a cast is being served dinner in front of a TV. Grizzy pretends to have a twisted ankle and shows the Lemmings the patient care illustrations. The imaginary invalid Grizzy is so convincing that the Lemmings fall for the trick. They think that the sooner Grizzy is healed, the sooner they will be able to throw him out of the cabin as planned.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: On the beach, the Lemmings have set up a mini funfair for tourists. Each attraction lets you to win tickets, which are then used to collect prizes from a vending machine. Grizzy, who is not very good at games of skill, steals the tickets collected by the Lemmings in order to obtain the jackpot. The Lemmings decide to create an attraction just for him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that oysters can make pearls almost instantaneously: just put an object inside their shell and it’s automatically coated with mother-of-pearl The game of marbles that the Lemmings have invented with pearls is driving Grizzy crazy. He manages to catapult the Lemmings far away. But at the ocean bottom, they discover a giant oyster. All they need to create a giant-scale marble game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have adopted a small exotic fish that’s lively and affectionate and have fun decorating its aquarium. Jealous, Grizzy finds a fish too, but his is expressionless and indifferent to the bear’s efforts to communicate. Grizzy plots to exchange the two fish behind the Lemmings' backs. He puts the affectionate fish in an even bigger aquarium with a pharaonic decor and locks the lid. But the Lemmings have no intention of leaving their friend to Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings use all the cans and tins they can get their hands on to build a beach slide. Grizzy, annoyed at not finding his tinned fish to prepare his meal tray, recovers them from the Lemmings. In their struggle, Grizzy loses his badge! Grizzy and the Lemmings now fight over a valuable metal detector that each party needs to accomplish their goal: build a slide or find the beloved badge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings take a liking to an endangered crab on the beach and decide to shelter it from a seagull who is using its shell to open coconuts. They bring it home to a disgruntled Grizzy, who wants to watch TV in peace while snacking on Cheetos. When the Lemmings turn into full-fledged crab rescuers, the house is soon overrun with crustaceans. Grizzy decides to use the seagull to get rid of the crabs. But the Lemmings - ready to do anything to protect their new friends - embark the entire house, like a raft on water.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: The Kazoom Kids must choose their hero name as they take on Cerealiak with the help of Mighty Moo.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Bam brings Catwoman's Catmobile, Kitty, to life so the Batwheels can have even teams for their game of Bat-Ball, but the Kitty Kitty is too wild to be contained, despite Bam's best attempts to convince her to play along.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Frustrated by the Batwheels’ distracting affinity for holiday festivities, Batwing decides to “go solo” to thwart Mr. Freeze’s evil Christmas-time plots. However, Batwing and the Batwheels soon realize that stopping Mr. Freeze is much harder when they all aren’t working together as a team.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After the rest of the Batwheels are incapacitated and Gotham’s beloved holiday mascot, Ike Cicle, is captured by Mr. Freeze, Batwing realizes that going solo isn’t all it’s cracked up to be. Now it’s up to her to rescue her friends, and work with them to save Christmas in Gotham.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Everyone assumes that Harley Quinn is the culprit in a recent burglary. But as Batman and Bam pursue Harley, Bibi and Redbird begin to suspect that she may actually be innocent.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired to build a festive course for the Fall foot race. Wile E. Coyote is determined to beat the Road Runner with his Robo-Runner despite its malfunctions.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: Curt Cuckoo hires The Looney Builders to build a giant cuckoo clock in Germany to signal the start of Martinstag. The crew struggles to get it right until they ask Curt for his help.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired to build a surfside hangout in Australia for a surfing competition. Bugs and Daffy want to compete but are a little out of their league until Taz offers to teach them.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Giovanna Badgerini to update her family’s pizzeria in Italy. However, Giovanna’s Mamma prefers the old way of doing things, which causes setbacks with the build until the crew helps them compromise.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Lola leads the crew in washing their vehicles only to discover she mixed up the job assignments.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean’s Birthday dinner gets off on the wrong foot when he and Teddy are made to take the worst table at a swanky restaurant. The evening is further ruined by a self-obsessed movie star at the next table. After a swim in the lobster tank, Mr. Bean unwittingly cooks up sweet revenge in the kitchen.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: During a visit to London's National Gallery, Bean witnesses the theft of a major work of art. Bloodhound that he is, he pursues the culprit across the Channel to Paris only to be waylaid by a Reliant Robin, a traffic jam, and a mime artist under the Eiffel Tower. Will Mr Bean ‘the International Art Sleuth’ prove successful?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to watch the motor racing on TV, when Mrs Wicket interrupts him to offer a deal – revamp her garden with new paving and ornaments, and he’ll get a month’s rent for free. Bean reluctantly agrees, but when he sees Mr Paliwal finish a personal training session and keen for more, he offers him a new workout… doing all Mr Bean’s work for him while he watches the racing! Win, win!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is bored of queuing for a trampoline park, so secretly bounces in through a window using a trampette. But he soon gets on the wrong side of a young show-off boy who keeps stealing Teddy and throwing him in hard-to-reach spots. To settle their row, they agree on a race around the trampoline park – first place wins Teddy. Will Mr Bean triumph before he’s chucked out for jumping the queue?

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput faints of thirst on a desert highway, so already it’s not a great day for the little orange shape-shifter. Add to that the fact that Specs and Skinny just happen by in a lockup van, and things go south pretty promptly. Specs and Skinny learn a valuable lesson: maybe if you’re going to anger a morphing super-blob by throwing them in the back of a van and withholding precious water, you shouldn’t do it whilst driving by a 100 foot cliff drop down to the open ocean. Hopefully these Docs are better swimmers than your average academic.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine with a jewelry ad showing a man offering a diamond to a woman, Grizzy imagines himself offering the ranger's engagement ring to his beloved she-bear. programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

The Lemmings have thrown themselves heart and soul into the regressive pleasure of paper airplanes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to carry out an investigation to find the trail of their treasure.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have got their hands on a pack of white beans which have very strange properties: when mixed with soda, anyone who eats them turns into a bouncing ball. Grizzy realizes that if he wants to take a nap, he must first get rid of the magic beans.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to get rid of the old piano in the garage at any cost, for the Lemmings love using it to make a dissonant racket. But when he happens to notice that the she-bear he's in love with likes the melody of Für Elise he decides to learn the learn the piece like a real pro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings inherit a crate that fell off a Canadian army convoy transporting ultra-secret material. programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Near the supermarket, a machine hands out surprise eggs in exchange for a coin. Amongst the lots to be won, there is a super firework rocket that makes the Lemmings dream, and a piece of costume jewelry that Grizzy imagines himself giving to his lady-love.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side? Well, it's kind of tiring pretending to be someone you're not. Lamput learns an important lesson from a nearby blobby little girl. Be yourself, and if anyone's got a problem with that, they can go find their own patch of sand.

programme.desc: Mrs Wicket makes Mr Bean drive her to the hospital to get her ingrown toenail seen to and asks him to wait. Mr Bean gets bored, and on a wander around the hospital he finds a spare doctor’s outfit with stethoscope – great Teddy - I’ll give you a check-up! But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Sometimes Mr. Bean’s Teddy can be no fun at all. Feeling the need for a new friend, Bean buys a parrot. But getting the parrot past his landlady and her one-eyed cat, Scrapper, proves to be no easy task. Next, is trying to get the blasted bird to speak.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings invent a new building game using pine cones clipped together. Baby Beaver tries to build a hut on a flat rock in the middle of the river, but his impatience and haste prevent him from succeeding. When he discovers the Lemmings pine cone construction, a magnificent amusement park, he decides to use it as a structure for his tree house.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby chipmunk has a collection of pretty gems. But when she loses a round one and it rolls past the Baby lemmings, they get the idea of organising a marble run. They collect lots of objects, cut them to make them spherical and... And off they go! But when the Baby chipmunk realises she's lost her stone, she wants it back. And when she sees all the new stones the Baby lemmings have collected, she wants them all back! But the baby lemmings have no intention of stopping their mad marble race through the forest!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Owl can't sleep without her little owl blankie. But she loses it because she's clumsy. When the baby lemmings discover it, they think it's so cool they decide to include it in their activities - it really is a good friend! In a panic, Baby Owl looks for her comforter and tries to get it back from the baby lemmings, but her clumsiness gives them the impression that she wants to harm the comforter! The baby lemmings decide to protect the comforter against all odds!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs takes a trip to Washington D.C. where he is mistaken for the First Rabbit. Vice-President Leslie P. Lilylegs sees ridding the White House of Bugs as his opportunity to finally get the promotion he deserves.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: A Barbarian and his trusty polar bear Krakos stake claim to the entire forest including Bugs' home.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Squeaks head to the African Savannah to visit Squeaks' cousin but first they have to outsmart the very hungry King of the Jungle Thes.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs is excited for a day of fun in the sun but The Winter Stag shows up delivering Winter long before it's due. Bugs intervenes.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Shaggy's friend Amelia invites Shaggy and the gang to a party. But Shaggy discovers that Amelia has become a goth. After realizing he has feelings for her Shaggy starts to feel bad that he hasn't changed at all so he decides he too will become a goth. But a mystery appears when an evil plant monster attacks the gang.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang gets caught up in international espionage and intrigue when they cross paths with British secret agent, Jenny Vex, and must help her complete her dangerous mission of stopping an evil mercenary called Minus from killing breakfast.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Inspired by a wildlife documentary on TV, Mr. Bean dusts off his camera and treks deep into the countryside in search of the perfect wildlife photograph. After two fruitless days of being the hunter, he is somewhat miffed to find himself the hunted.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Tom is watching a hypnotist on TV, when the words you are asleep hit him hard. He becomes a virtual rag doll and ends up in a jumble of junk for Rick and Ginger's yard sale. A woman who thinks he's a stuffed animal buys him. Jerry feels bad and hops aboard the car to rescue Tom.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Tom falls asleep inside a rolled-up carpet left out on the curb by Rick with a free sign attached. When the new owners unload their pickup truck and leave the carpet in front of their home, a sleepy Tom doesn't notice at first that everything is similar to, but a little different than, his usual surroundings. Soon Tom feels that he's landed in bizarro world.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: After a series of beatings from Tom, Jerry storms off into his mouse hole. Soon he falls asleep and dreams himself to be the Lord of Downton Abbey! Tom is now servant to Lord Jerry, and the Master wastes no time in making Tom's life miserable. Tom is caught in the act of exacting revenge, so Lord Jerry challenges Tom to a duel in the dream world.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side? Well, it's kind of tiring pretending to be someone you're not. Lamput learns an important lesson from a nearby blobby little girl. Be yourself, and if anyone's got a problem with that, they can go find their own patch of sand.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings play pirates on a beached boat. Grizzy, who is fishing further down, realizes that with the Lemmings’ boat, he could come closer to a zone that’s teeming with fish. Grizzy takes a malicious pleasure playing pirate himself to unseat the Lemmings and steal their boat. The Lemmings discover a chest containing real pirate belongings. A telescope conjures the owner’s ghost who immediately places his saber and hook at their disposal.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy sets sail with his fishing gear. But he has no intention of fishing: it's a scheme to enjoy a jar of Yummy chocolate spread alone in peace. The Lemmings sense the subterfuge and sink his boat to get the treat, which sinks to the ocean depths. The characters dive in pursuit and discover a school of intelligent crabs that live in an underwater city. Their treasure is a substance that’s even yummier than Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find the cabin upside down. Upon closer inspection, it looks like an epic battle took place there. And Grizzy isn't here. The curious Lemmings start imagining what could have happened, visualizing the most improbable scenes for us. They decide to follow their lead to find Grizzy and confirm their zany theories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy dreams of drinking some nice cold coconut milk on the couch. Step one, get rid of the Lemmings who are having fun flying through the living room. Two, find coconuts that haven't been emptied of their nectar. While Grizzy struggles to pick coconuts that are too high up, the Lemmings find a magic conch. By simply dusting yourself with its sand, you can fly! It doesn't take Grizzy long to figure this out and the bear rapidly imagines himself as Peter Pan sipping on his easily-harvested coconut milk.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to watch TV in peace. The Lemmings have other plans: they want to have fun playing music with homemade instruments. Exasperated by the racket they're making in the garage, Grizzy destroys the instruments and sends the Lemmings flying. The Lemmings discover a magic ukulele that bewitches anyone who hears its music: the perfect tool to regain control of the cabin and get back to their concert.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy can't sleep because it's too hot. He decides to confiscate the fans the Lemmings use to power their fake spaceship. Totally into their Space Opera game, the Lemmings try to repel the alien Grizzy with laser party favors and are propelled onto an unknown planet: a volcano crater with a secret base where a rocket is ready to take off. The rocket carries the cabin into space. It's no longer a game: Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to face the dangers of outer space!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: The Kazoom Kids infiltrate Mr. King’s base to take back the Kazoom and save Kaboom City, but Kid Fury gets trapped inside.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Buff trains with Batwing to improve his gracefulness and uses her lessons on a delicate mission against the Riddler.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Badcomputer captures Bibi and disguises Jestah to take her place with the Batwheels so that Jestah can steal the Batcomputer’s motherboard. Can Bibi get free in time to unmask the imposter and save the day?

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When the Legion of Zoom plan to cheat their way to winning the Gotham Grand Prix, the Batwheels zoom into action to ensure the race is won the right way - fair and square !

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Green Arrow and his Arrowplane, Goldie, come to help Batman take on the Riddler. Batwing is so happy to have another flying vehicle around that she brings Goldie to life and the two become BFFs. But when Goldie eventually has to leave, Batwing learns that saying goodbye doesn't always mean forever!

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: Carina Capybara hires The Looney Builders to build her Samba School a float for Brazil’s Carnaval parade. She soon realizes the float will be even better if they incorporate her students’ ideas, and they all work together to revise the design.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Parth Peacock to build a puppet stage and puppets in India. They soon learn that Parth’s form of puppetry differs from their own and must correct everything in time for his big show.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: After a hot cocoa disaster, Santa Claus hires The Looney Builders to build him a new toyshop in time to save Christmas.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Mayor Foghorn Leghorn hires The Looney Builders to build a giant water slide for Looneyburg’s waterpark. He keeps adding onto the design with the support of Bugs until problems arise.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: The crew plays Hide N’ Seek at headquarters and Tweety is the seeker.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Who's afraid of daft films about giant killer cats, blobs from outer space and thumb-size men who dance around in sugar bowls? Mr. Bean is. He's very afraid. A trip to the cinema makes Mr. Bean’s imagination play tricks on him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Against his better judgement, Bean has agreed to go out on a proper date with Irma Gobb, his girlfriend. She has the perfect evening planned: a romantic film followed by a candlelit dinner for two. If only she had the perfect boyfriend to go with it.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is struggling to sell items from her knitwear stall at the market, so sends Mr Bean to collect a sheep costume he can wear to attract customers. Once at the fancy dress shop however, Mr Bean gets stuck in the sheep costume and has to travel back to the market wearing it. Things go from bad to worse when Mr Bean takes a short cut across the field and gets caught up in a flock of real sheep!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a rare book - the Teddy Bear Haunting - in a bookshop, but it’s too expensive to buy. He secretly tries to read it in the shop… until he’s thrown out. To his dismay someone else then buys the book – so he follows the buyer around trying to read over his shoulder. Will Mr Bean manage to get to the end of the book before getting spotted?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have discovered an addictive new game based on the astonishing bouncing properties of the ranger's new running shoes. Grizzy, who is trying to relax, confiscates the shoes and soon realizes they are far more comfortable than his thongs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy babysits for the she-bear he has a crush on, who has entrusted him with the care of her cub. There's no question of Grizzy tripping up, for he has no intention of taking any risks! But he hadn't reckoned on the Lemmings. Captivated by the baby's burps after meals, they dream of making it drink gallons of soda pop to make it do the Big One.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Unwilling to share the food both he and the Lemmings are wild about, Grizzy locks it up inside the ranger’s brand new and apparently burglar proof safe. He watches the Lemmings’ vain attempts to open the safe with amusement, until he realizes that the string around his neck with the key is far from indestructible.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is impressed by the TV show of a magician who transforms a partridge into a bouquet of flowers. To get rid of the Lemmings once and for all, for they exasperate him with their incessant games, Grizzy tries the magic trick on them. And apparently... it works!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: It's hot out and when Grizzy sees an ice cream commercial on TV, he has a sudden craving. Unfortunately, the Lemmings made it to the deep-freeze in the garage before him and emptied it out to make themselves a sled run in the backyard with strawberry-vanilla ice cream. For Grizzy, there's no question that the stock they possessively watch over in an icebox winds up as powder snow!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have discovered a truly wild new game: an augmented reality program on the ranger's digital tablet. They move around the cabin watching the tablet screen, which displays obstacles as if they were really there. Grizzy confiscates this toy and becomes a fan of the salmon fishing game.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The only edible food item left in the ranger's cabin is a gorgeous salmon... which is stuck inside a block of ice at the back of the freezer compartment. Starving, Grizzy decides to melt the ice with the blow-dryer. Only the Lemmings are already using it for their latest rocket game in the piping system.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a box filled with birthday

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy's last jar of chocolate spread was pinched by the Lemmings, who are savoring it in secret. To localize the Lemmings hiding place, Grizzy trains a raccoon, whose sense of smell equals that of a truffle hound to detect the scent of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Wedged in his sofa to relieve his aching back, Grizzy balks at getting up. He designs clever strategies to do everything from a distance, including confiscating the Lemming's radio-controlled toy robot-transformer which he will use as a butler.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The vibrations created by Grizzy's snoring during his nap give the Lemmings an idea for a bouncing game. But when Grizzy changes positions and his snoring stops, the Lemmings must find other sources of vibrations. Only these are no longer compatible with Grizzy's nap.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a birthday piñata in the ranger's living room. The idea of bursting open a papier-mâché statue with a bat like it says in the instructions pleases him. The Lemmings, who prefer to use it as a toy to swing from, are determined to stop Grizzy from destroying the piñata.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Inside a mysterious cave, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a magical Game of the Goose. The events displayed in the squares that the players land on come true in real life. When Grizzy and the Lemmings realize, it's too late to stop the game.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is bothered by an object stuck in between the sofa cushions: a big fur lemming puppet glove. He puts his hand inside and has fun pretending that the puppet is strangling him. The Lemmings believe that the puppet is a Super Lemming who's stronger than Grizzy and start to obey it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the leftovers of a Halloween party in the ranger's cabin, which was entirely redecorated for the occasion, with stupefaction. But if the curious ambiance perturbs Grizzy, the Lemmings are in seventh heaven and have a whale of a time jumping up and down inside a cooking pot full of marshmallows. Grizzy wants to get rid of it until he accidentally swallows a marshmallow and discovers the best flavor of his life.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Specs and Skinny spruce themselves up and head out to a piano concerto in the royal concert hall. They're on their best behavior, until they spot a fellow culture vulture who also happens to be small, orange and squishy. Honestly, they're letting all sorts of rabble into these places these days. The Docs decide that a sleeping potion might be a quick and quiet way of capturing Lamput. Naturally things get out of hand, and when the entire audience catches a whiff of the snoozy brew, we find out exactly how hard it is to stay awake during a classical music recital. One star.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: MoleTown is becoming lazy and so Dotty helps Moley exercise, giving the Gardener an idea, he sets up a Golf Course to trap Manny, but things don’t go to plan.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Molieres travelling spectacular comes to MoleTown, it brings with it, a rather unique guest, which soon becomes very attached to Dotty.

programme.desc: Skatītāji tiek iepazīstināti ar Dalijas Dipolito - divdesmit sešus gadus vecās eskorta meitenes - tiesas prāvām, kuras kļuva par bēdīgi slaveno femme fatale un mediju sensāciju. Viņai tika izvirzītas apsūdzības par uzmākšanos sava vīra Maika slepkavībai.

programme.title: Pirmās 48
programme.desc: Kad mīļotais vectēvs tiek nošauts savās mājās Talsā, izmeklētāji cenšas atrast pavedienu.

programme.title: Pazudis
programme.desc: Kad 15 gadus vecā Kaila Berga pēc naktsdzīves nav pārnākusi mājās, viņas mīļotie tic, ka viņa palikusi pie draugiem. Paiet sešas dienas, un atklājas, ka meitene pazudusi. Fakti par pazušanu raisa aizdomas nelielajā pilsētā.

programme.title: Noslepkavots no rīta
programme.desc: Dodžsitijā divas sievietes devušās nakts dzīvē, kur sastopas ar potenciālajiem piegulētājiem. Līdz ar rīta gaismu atklājas, ka viena no sievietēm savās mājās atrasta mirusi. Sākas izmeklēšana par viņas pēdējām dzīves stundām.

programme.title: Vientuļā dzērusī sieviete
programme.desc: Semas jaunatklātā pašapziņa tiek satricināta - viņa uzzina, ka viņas jaunais priekšnieks ir pagātnes rēgs. Tikmēr Felīcija kļūdās, apsveicot savu draugu ar viņa paaugstināšanu amatā. Un Olīvija pieņem dzīvi mainošu lēmumu.

programme.title: Noziegums kuru atcerēties
programme.desc: Losandželosa, 1922. gads. Tiek atrasts miris vīrs, un viņa sieva atrasta ieslodzīta skapī. Izmeklētāji procesā apmaldās pakļaušanas un apsēstības pasaulē, kur spoki ir vairāk nekā īsti.

programme.title: Algota slepkavība
programme.desc: Greizsirdība un apsēstība sasniedz kulmināciju - īpašniecisks narcissists ratiņkrēslā izstrādā metodisku plānu nogalināt savu neko nenojaušošo bijušo draudzeni.

programme.title: Pirmās 48
programme.desc: Alabamas štata Mobilā 21 gadu vecu sievieti viesnīcas numuriņā nošauj noslēpumains apmeklētājs. 42 gadus vecs mūzikas producents atrasts Gvinetas apgabala dzīvoklī sašauts. Pazīmes liecina par ārprātīgu vīrieti, kas ir iesaistīts apšaudē.

Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk and Tim Minear reimagine the procedural drama with 9-1-1. The series explores the high-pressure experiences of first responders -- including police officers, firefighters and dispatchers -- who are thrust into the most frightening, shocking and heart-stopping situations. These emergency responders must try to balance saving those who are at their most vulnerable with solving the problems in their own lives. The show draws from real-life, high-pressure experiences of first responders who regularly face heart-stopping situations that are often unpredictable, intense and uplifting at the same time.

Atradimas neleidžia Mozliui ramiai gyventi ir jis nusprendžia sprukti iš ūkio. Pabėgę nuo pikto šeimininko, Mozlis ir Ru tikisi rasti paslaptingą miestą, kuriame vis dar gyvuoja dvikojų dramblūnų gentis.

programme.title: Le Manas'66. Plento karaliai
programme.desc: Dviem Oskarais apdovanota, tikrais įvykiais paremta juosta apie lenktynes, pakeitusias „Ford“ markės automobilių istoriją. Prestižinėse „Le Mano“ lenktynėse karaliaujantis „Ferrari“ buvo nenugalimas. Tačiau tai įkvėpė „Ford“ vadovą Henrį Fordą II siekti sėkmės bet kokia kaina. Jis žengė rizikingą ir labai abejotiną sėkmę žadantį žingsnį. Į komandą pasikvietęs genialų ir talentingą lenktynininką Keną Mailsą (Christian Bale) ir išradingąjį inžinierių Kerolą Šelbį (Matt Damon) jis davė savo komandai tris mėnesius iki naujų lenktynių. Po alinančio darbo, įtampos ir bemiegių naktų, tai, kas atrodė neįmanoma, tapo realybe. Visiškai naujas „Ford GT40” nuvertė nuo sosto „Ferrari“ ir buvo nepralenkiamas trejus metus. „Ford GT40“ modelis tapo legenda ir geriausiai atpažįstamu automobilių pasaulio istorijoje.

Šaunieji „Ledynmečio“ herojai priversti leistis į pavojingą kelionę, kad išvaduotų savo draugą iš paslaptingo, nepažįstamo ir bauginančio pasaulio. Šioje nuotykių nestokojančioje odisėjoje jiems teks susidurti su naujais pavojais. Tačiau vieni jie neliks. World Autism Awareness Day is on 2nd April.

programme.title: Dino Dana
programme.desc: Dana on innukas 10-aastane tüdruk, kes armastab dinosauruseid. Kohe nii väga, et isa valmistas talle erilise seljakoti, mille abil ta saab muutuda ükskõik milliseks dinosauruseks. Ees ootavad vägevad dinoseiklused!

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Andy eelajaloolised seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab muuseumis ning tema kasutada on ajamasin, mis viib ta tagasi eelajaloolisse aega, et ta saaks sealt kaasa tuua sulgi, luid ja kõike muud, mida muuseumi ekspositsioon vajab. Tänu oma seljakotis olevatele vajalikele abivahenditele jõuab ta alati ohutult tänapäeva muuseumi tagasi.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Andy seiklused dinosaurustega
programme.desc: Muuseumis töötav Andy avastab salajase portaali, mis viib ta dinosauruste aega tagasi.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Meister igal alal
programme.desc: Kümme noorsportlast osalevad ülimal spordivõistlusel. Trikk on aga selles, et nad ei võistle oma spordialadel, vaid teiste võistlejate aladel. Võistluse lõpus enim punkte kogunud sportlane pälvib tiitli Meister igal alal.

programme.title: Lahedad loomad
programme.desc: Alates surfavatest hiirtest ja maalivatest koertest kuni rääkivate hobuste ning trühvlisigadeni. Kõige kavalamad, nunnumad ja pöörasemad loomad.

programme.title: Andy safari seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab Safari maailmas, kogu Maakera kõige suuremas ja paremas looduspargis koos oma ülemuse, härra Hammondi ja tehnikavõluri Jeniga. Mistahes huvitav ülesanne teda ees ka ei ootaks, kihutab Andy oma safari-autoga kohale.

programme.title: Ajuvabalt palju küsimusi
programme.desc: Keni aju esitab muudkui uusi huvitavaid küsimusi: Kas on võimalik end kuule katapulteerida? Kas koerad suudavad rääkida? Mis juhtuks, kui kogu maailm tuleks sinu juurde teed jooma? Õnneks aitab tema sõber Leila nendele küsimustele vastused leida.

programme.title: Andy veeseiklused
programme.desc: Andy naaseb vaimustavate veeseiklustega. Avasta temaga koos veekogusid üle kogu maakera ning kohtu delfiinide, vaalade ja muude hämmastavate loomadega.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed

programme.title: Kotrynos burtai
programme.desc: Maisto tinklaraštininkė, nuomonės formuotoja, knygų autorė Kotryna Starkienė imsis užduoties ruošti patiekalus iš sezoninių produktų, savo sodyboje Dzūkijoje užaugintų daržovių, surinktų uogų, grybų ar iš vietinių augintojų pirktos mėsos. Kotryna gamins tiek kasdienius, kiekvienam lengvai paruošiamus patiekalus, tiek šventinius, skirtus specialioms progoms, nepamiršdama desertų. Laidoje bus ir buitinių patarimų – kaip paprasčiausiai išvalyti skalbimo mašiną, kaip padaryti, kad medinės pjaustymo lentelės vėl atrodytų, kaip naujos, kaip išlyginti staltiesę, kai neturite lygintuvo.

programme.title: Angelas sargas
programme.desc: Šivradžas ir Rasal – vienas kitą mylintys brolis ir sesuo. Netekę mylimos mamos, vaikai užgauliojami bendraamžių ir engiami kaimynų. Brolis jaučia didelę atsakomybę apsaugoti mažąją sesutę, tad tampa tikru apsaugos skydu kasdieniuose iššūkiuose. Gyvenimas pasisuka dramatiškai, kai vaiku tėvas patenka į avariją ir susiduria su paslaptingos ginkluotos grupuotės nariais. Dabar vaikams teks dar labiau saugoti vienam kitą. Ar meilė ir ištikimybė padės išlikti kartu klastinguose gyvenimo posūkiuose? Ar blogo linkintys niekšai palauš vaikų pasitikėjimą vienas kitu?

programme.title: Sveikatos medis
programme.desc: Televizijos laida „Sveikatos medis“ – tarsi televizinis žurnalas, kurio tikslas – svarbios, naudingos, aktualios ir pačios naujausios medicininės, farmacinės ir sveikatingumo naujienos. Laidą sudaro 4 rubrikos – „Sveikatos naujienos“, „Ačiū, daktare“, „Vaistininkas pataria“ ir „Gyvenkime sveikai“ – tad kas savaitę laidoje bus apžvelgiamas platus temų spektras. Laidos pašnekovai bus ne tik mokslo daktarai, profesoriai ar ministrai, bet ir eiliniai praeiviai gatvėje. Laidos vedėja – daktarė, ilgametė sveikatos laidų vedėja ir kūrėja Irena Pivoriūnienė.

programme.title: Slaptas augintinių gyvenimas 2
programme.desc: Prieš kurį laiką šunelio Makso gyvenimą aukštyn kojomis apvertęs įbrolis Djukas nebetrikdo kasdienybės. Dabar jo gyvenime atsiranda naujas iššūkis – pasirūpinti tik ką gimusiu šeimininkės kūdikėliu. Perdėtas rūpinimasis Maksui įvaro nervinį tiką, ir draugų kompanija visais būdais bando jį įtikinti, kad laikas atsipalaiduoti. O štai triušelis Snaigius ir Ši Cu veislės kalytė Deizė skuba gelbėti tigro, patekusio į cirką prieš savo valią. Cirko prižiūrėtojas yra gerai žinomas tironas, kuris siekia kankinančiais būdais išdresuoti taikų tigrą. Žaismingoji kalytė Gidžet privalo žūtbūt susigrąžinti jai saugoti patikėtą žaislą. Trys nuostabios, pamokančios istorijos ir mielų herojų akistata su didžiausiomis jų baimėmis. Visas baimes padeda nugalėti geriausi draugai, tad istorijos baigsis laimingai.

programme.title: galvOK

programme.title: Viena diena
programme.desc: Jauna, neturtinga, tyros sielos svajotoja visiems linki tik gero. Baigdama universitetą ji susipažįsta su nerūpestingu mergišiumi Deksteriu. Šis į gyvenimą žvelgia lengvabūdiškai, nes sunkumų jis neturi. Pamatysime, kaip ši pora bendrauja dvidešimt metų. Kaip patiria džiaugsmus, sunkumus, širdgėlą. Kaip siekia įgyvendinti svajones ir kaip jų požiūris į gyvenimą nuolat keičiasi.

programme.title: Nesunaikinami 2
programme.desc: Į Barnį Rosą (akt. Sylvesteris Stallone) kreipiasi žmogus iš CŽV ir paprašo Barnio ir jo samdinių komandos paimti sudužusio lėktuvo juodąją dėžę. Kartu Čerčas (akt. Bruce'as Willisas) išsiunčia moterį vardu Megė, kuri turi užtikrinti, kad jis atliktų savo misiją. Jie suranda lėktuvą ir paima juodąją dėžę, tačiau Barnio žmones kažkas iš pasalų užpuola, o užpuolikų vadeiva (akt. Jean-Claude'as Van Damme'as) pareikalauja, kad jie atiduotų tai, ką turi, arba jis nužudysiąs įkaitą. Barnio komanda atiduoda užpuolikams tai, ką rado, tačiau šie vis tiek nužudo įkaitą. Barnis paklausia Megės, kuo tokia svarbi ši juodoji dėžė. Ši atsako, kad pagal ją galima sužinoti, kur yra Rusijos plutonio saugykla. Dabar Barnis vyksta į sudėtingą misiją susekti plutonio ieškotojus.

programme.title: Sparno broliai
programme.desc: Tikrų įvykių įkvėptas filmas apie JAV laivyno pilotą Džesį Brauną (akt. Jonathan Majors). Vaikinas siekė svajonės dėdamas nežmoniškas pastangas ir demonstruodamas milžinišką valią ir užsispyrimą. Juk tuo metu pietinėse Amerikos valstijose juodaodžiams net nebuvo leidžiama mokytis ar važiuoti tuo pačiu autobusu, kuriuo važiuoja baltieji. Diskriminacijos šešėlis nesustabdė Džsesio ir jis tapo vienu geriausiu JAV laivyno pilotu. Įsiplieskus Korėjos karui Džesis su kovos draugais buvo paskirtas į karščiausią tašką. Jo būrio draugu tapo ir Tomas Hadneris, (akt. Glen Powell), kuris įprastame gyvenime toli gražu nelaikė juodaodžių sau lygiais. Tačiau labai greitai jo nusistatymai tampa nieko verti, nes mirties akivaizdoje vienintelis svarbus dalykas – pasitikėjimas būrio draugu.

programme.title: Svajonių sodai
programme.desc: Naujajame „Svajonių sodų sezone kviečiame žiūrovus į nepakartojamą kelionę po gražiausius Europos sodus ir parkus. Laidos žiūrovai bus supažindinti ne tik su garsiais botanikos sodais ir istoriniais parkais, bet ir privačių želdintojų kūriniais, kurie paprastai neprieinami plačiajai visuomenei. Žiūrovai turės galimybę pamatyti šiuos gamtos šedevrus skirtingais metų laikais – nuo pavasario žydėjimo ir vasaros žalumos iki rudens spalvų žaismo. Kiekviena laida atskleis unikalias sodininkystės tradicijas ir inovatyvius kraštovaizdžio sprendimus. Tai bus tikra šventė visų gamtos mylėtojų akims ir širdims.

programme.title: Bruto ir Neto
programme.desc: Serialas žiūrovus vėl nukels į įprastą lietuvišką kaimą, kuriame dedasi visai neįprasti dalykai. Keršto vedamas aktoriaus Vaidoto Martinaičio vaidinamas Pranas mintimis grįš į laikus, kai bandydamas atsisakyti alkoholio apsigyveno arabų kraštuose. Būdamas šiltuose kraštuose Pranas išmoko maisto gaminimo paslapčių, todėl nuspręs Gaisrių kaime atidaryti restoraną, susilauksiantį neregėto populiarumo. Tačiau pagrindinis Prano tikslas bus pasipriešinti konkurentams – naujai hipsterių porai, kurių vaidmenis atliks aktoriai Karina Stungytė ir Eimutis Kvosčiauskas. Naujajame serialo sezone – ne tik įspūdinga Prano priešistorė ir netikėta sėkmė. Serialo ašimi tampa linksmieji Bruto bei Neto, kuriuos negailestingos gyvenimo aplinkybės ir vėl atbloškia į nuošaliausią Lietuvos vietą. Nutrūktagalviai draugai vis atsiduria iki ašarų juoktis verčiančiose situacijose, iš kurių išsisukti – beveik neįmanoma. Seriale pagrindinius vaidmenis ir toliau kuria aktoriai Šarūnas Banevičius ir Jonas Gricius, Vaidotas Martinaitis, Asta Baukutė ir kiti. Šiame sezone taip pat bus galima išvysti kitus žymius aktorius bei garsenybes – Inetą Stasiulytę, Vaidą Baumilą, Valdą Burnį, Rafailą Karpį, Viktoriją Šaulytę.

programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: Naujojo TV3 sezono „Mano TV3. Gera kartu!“ premjera – lietuviškas serialas „Moterų laimė“ yra kuriamas pagal visame pasaulyje didžiulio populiarumo sulaukusį daugiaserijinį filmą. Pastarasis yra rodomas daugiau nei penkiasdešimtyje pasaulio šalių, tarp kurių – Rusija, JAV, Kanada, Indija, Meksika, o serialo žiūrimumas svetur – rekordiškas didelis. Pagrindiniais smuikais seriale griežia penkios gražios, stiprios ir labai skirtingos herojės, kurias jungs bendras darbas, draugystė ir bėdos. „Stiprios moterys verkia tyliai... Rytoj bus geriau!“ – tokiu požiūriu gyvenimo negandas pasitiks serialo veikėjos. Autentiškas, dramatiškas ir pamokančias gyvenimo istorijas perteiks talentingos Lietuvos aktorės – Gabija Ryškuvienė, Daiva Tamošiūnaitė, Vaida Būtytė, Goda Petkutė bei Akvilina Ubartaitė. „Moterų laimės“ herojės – sostinėje gyvenančios keturios moterys. Visos jos – labai skirtingos. Skirtingi jų siekiai ir ieškojimai. Viena mėgina tapti laiminga, kita ieško meilės, trečia pradeda lipti karjeros laiptais, ketvirta visomis keturiomis kabinasi į gyvenimą. Šitame kelyje – daugybė kliūčių, kurias moterims teks įveikti. Penktoji, pagrindinė herojė patirs ir praradimo skausmą ir netikėto atradimo džiaugsmą.

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.
